<void/>Void Invisibility lasts 2 seconds longer.

Entering <void/>Void Invisibility grants one stack of “Vanishing Shadow” for 7 seconds. Vanishing Shadow's timer does not decrease while <void/>Invisibile. Vanishing Shadow stacks up to 3 times. Additional stacks can only be gained after exiting <void/>Invisibility.

Each stack of Vanishing Shadow grants improved base ability regeneration rate at 1|2|3 stacks.
• Class Ability: 67%|133%|200% 
• Grenade: 166%|333%|500% 
• Melee: 166%|333%|500%

Reaching Vanishing Shadow x3 or gaining <void/>Void Invisibility while at Vanishing Shadow x3 grants you a 15HP <void/>Void Overshield for 7 seconds (10 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence).
